title: Samples
noDirs: No sample folder is set. Add it in Settings > Folders.
indexing: Spool is reading your samples in the background. They will show up here as it goes.
none: No sample found in your sample folders.
noneTip: Their name and folders do not say what they are, or say two things at once.
howTip: Sorted by their name and folders. A key keeps the loops in that key or its relative, and the one-shots on a note of its scale; a tempo also keeps half and double time.
listening: The audio analysis is listening to the {n} unsorted samples: {time} left.
toListen: {n} unsorted samples will be listened to by the audio analysis, in the background.
compared: Compared with the {n} samples the audio analysis has listened to so far.
dragTip: Drag it into Live or a folder.

used.label: Use
used.tip: The samples your projects use, or those none uses
used.rowTip: The songs with a project using this sample

dupes.tip: Samples kept in several copies (same name, size and content)
dupes.title: Duplicate samples
dupes.summary: {n} samples kept twice or more, {mb} MB too many
dupes.note: Show a copy in Explorer to tidy up. Careful, a project may use any of the copies.
dupes.summaryMore: At least {n} samples kept twice or more (the largest), {mb} MB too many

alikeNotInLibrary: "{name}" is not in your sample library (it is a file of the project, a freeze or a bounce): there is nothing to compare it with.
fromNeighbours: From the samples next to it in its folder
longTip: Over a minute long: recordings rather than samples, not listened to.
unreadableTip: The audio analysis could not decode them (rare format, damaged file or access denied). Many still play.

sort.title: Sort this sample
sort.folder: Also the other unsorted ones in this folder

quick.tip: The unsorted ones one at a time: listen, then one key to confirm or correct.
quick.title: Sort by ear
quick.keys: Enter confirms, 1 to 8 picks the family, S skips, Space replays, Backspace undoes.
quick.finished: Done: {n} samples sorted. Spool uses them to sort the others.
quick.byFolderTip: The folders with the most unsorted samples: listen to a few, one key sorts the whole folder.
quick.keysFolder: Enter confirms, 1 to 8 sorts the whole folder, Tab plays the next example, S skips the folder, Backspace undoes.
quick.filesKeys: {n} files: a click plays one, ↑ ↓ go to the previous or next.

noteHeard: Note heard by listening (the name gives none)
notesHeard: Notes heard in this loop (the name gives no key): {notes}. The key filter keeps it when they all are in the scale.

ask.title: Sort by ear
ask.noGuess: No idea for these: listen and pick.
ask.alikeTip: Samples from other folders that sound almost the same: your answer sorts them too. Untick the ones that do not belong.
ask.follow: {n} more sound like what you just sorted
ask.followSub: They come from other folders. Same answer?
ask.keys: Enter confirms, 1 to 9 picks the family, S skips, Space plays again, ↑ ↓ change sample, X ticks or unticks, Backspace undoes.
ask.inFolderTip: The whole folder, sorted ones too, with what your songs use.
ask.confirmText: These files will really leave your sample folder. They go to the Windows Recycle Bin, where you can still restore them.

confirmUsed.one: Careful: {n} of them is used in a song, which will no longer find it.
confirmUsed.other: Careful: {n} of them are used in songs, which will no longer find them.

deleted.one: {n} sample sent to the Recycle Bin
deleted.other: {n} samples sent to the Recycle Bin

famTip.drums: One drum hit: kick, snare, clap, hi-hat, cymbal, tom, percussion.
famTip.drumloop: A drum loop alone: a beat, hats, percussion, a fill, a break.
famTip.bass: A bass, looped or one-shot: 808, sub, synth bass, growl.
famTip.melodic: One instrument playing notes: lead, pad, pluck, keys, guitar, strings, brass...
famTip.vocal: A voice: a phrase, a chop, a chant, an acapella.
famTip.fx: A production effect: riser, downlifter, impact, sweep, noise, glitch.
famTip.fullloop: A loop where several instruments play together (drums, bass, melody): a piece of a track, ready to drop in.
famTip.demo: A pack's preview or a whole track (demo, preview, full mix), longer than a loop.
famTip.ambience: A place, a crowd or a gesture recorded, not played: field recording, city or nature ambience, audience, foley.
